from_port.description: Origin port: MSC port id (digits, e.g. 78) or UN/LOCODE (5 letters, e.g. USMSY). Pattern: ^([0-9]{1,6}|[A-Za-z]{5})$.

include_port_calls.description: Include every intermediate port call per leg (large).

to_port.description: Destination port: MSC port id or UN/LOCODE (e.g. GEPTI). Pattern: ^([0-9]{1,6}|[A-Za-z]{5})$.
